Class IngredientService

java.lang.Object

  • Method Details

    • findAlternative

      public String findAlternative(String ingredient, String restriction, boolean isDietary)
      Finds a substitute for a given ingredient based on availability or dietary restriction.
      Parameters:
      ingredient - The ingredient to be substituted.
      restriction - The type of restriction (e.g., "gluten-free").
      isDietary - True if the restriction is dietary; false if it's due to availability.
      Returns:
      The substitute ingredient, or null if no substitute is found.

    • isDietaryCompliant

      public boolean isDietaryCompliant(String ingredient, String restriction)
      Checks if a given ingredient is compliant with a specific dietary restriction.
      Parameters:
      ingredient - The ingredient to check.
      restriction - The dietary restriction (e.g., "gluten-free").
      Returns:
      True if the ingredient is compliant; false if it violates the restriction.

    • isAvailable

      public boolean isAvailable(String ingredient)
      Checks whether an ingredient is currently available in stock.
      Parameters:
      ingredient - The ingredient to check.
      Returns:
      True if the ingredient is available; false otherwise.
